package.name: sensor_fusion
package.description: Camera-LiDAR fusion: projection.py (LiDAR point <-> pixel, lens model, ground plane, cone boxes; numpy only), lidar_camera_calib.py (camera-LiDAR extrinsic calibration with a checkerboard, Zhang-Pless), calib_capture / calib_solve (record + solve a session on the car), calib_fake_session (test without hardware), fake_camera (the simulator's camera + YOLO -> /camera/detections) + demos.
